detects.chromatic_class: the PBD class: lit member set per index, tint energies/ratio, tir fractions (entry measure x Fresnel through one kernel on a plate family sample)
detects.chromatic_diagnose: the colour verdict (kind/color/visible), every feature's criterion quantities, the threshold snapshot (N_RED/N_BLUE/EDGE_MIN_SHIFT_RAD/EDGE_SPREAD_PER_SHIFT/TINT_RATIO_MIN)
detects.dp_field_kinks: TIR-onset curve structure (step/margin/method, arc count, closed, ends) and D envelope per index; the constant circles pin their closed-form value (3-1-6, C06)
detects.dp_field_sample: D_P / gradient / U_P gate margins / A_P / T_P / w at fixed u: chain or index drift, gate-set change, corridor (entry measure) regression, weight-kernel mismatch
detects.dp_field_topology: partition bounds and counts, critical values, corner margin signatures, degenerate-fold fields, domain topology counts: partition escapes, corner Newton, slab-crease gates, chart audit
detects.focusing_classify: the kind-1 onset table and its labels (mechanism, profile, jacobian_focusing, multiplicity), gradient_norm_range, family_pinned
detects.wavelength_critical_table: onset displacement across n(lambda): the wavelength-critical preset (task 42.4)

cell.rationale: the C02 criterion layer: the kink edge is blue/visible while the exit gate is red/not visible (sigma 108.7 deg against |Delta| 0.33 deg), the divergence from the issue's expected red gate recorded in chromatic-module-c.md "Evidence"

input.angles_convention: radians; delta_red/delta_blue are the median D of the feature's line at each index

thresholds.authority: lumice_integral.chromatic; this block is a recorded snapshot, not a second implementation

feature_angles.basis: absolute, rad, per feature (delta_red, delta_blue, shift, spread, direction_dispersion): medians and spreads over a backend's own sampling of the same curve: march spacing ~3.5e-3 rad on the closed-form circles and the curves are traced to curve accuracy, so medians/ptp agree at the spacing level; 2e-3 rad is half the observed spacing.  Cells with a closed-form value (the constant kinks) are pinned tighter by the anchor tests, not by this tolerance

feature_fractions.basis: absolute (positive_fraction, contrast, lit_fraction) and weight relative: sampled medians over a backend's own curve sampling

position.basis: absolute, rad: medians and spreads over a backend's own sampling of the same curve: march spacing ~3.5e-3 rad on the closed-form circles and the curves are traced to curve accuracy, so medians/ptp agree at the spacing level; 2e-3 rad is half the observed spacing.  Cells with a closed-form value (the constant kinks) are pinned tighter by the anchor tests, not by this tolerance

verdict.basis: exact: kind, color, visible, coverage_complete, notes and the feature list in order (kind, source, color, visible)
